bass_routing_headroom_proxy.notice: Conservative coherent-input routing/FIR/output-level proxy. This excludes unknown AVR gain order, internal attenuation, driver distortion and available acoustic output; it is not a clipping or SPL certificate.

auditory_balance.notice: Relative matching of confirmed same-model speakers. This response-energy method is not an ISO loudness calculation or a verified reproduction of GSonic. The full measured FFT grid contributes to the auditory bands; raw impulses are unchanged.

receiver_calibration.notice: Modeled native-menu proposal using every measured FFT bin in the declared analysis band and every retained repeat. The finite-grid search is exact for its stated conditional model and fixed FIRs. Receiver routing, capture gain/delay path and native reconstruction remain unverified. Polarity is a filter choice, not a diagnosis of reversed wiring.

auditory_balance.notice: One shared native trim state minimizes the weighted mean of per-curve ERB Huber costs with zero-sum group changes. This is a conditional level-matching objective, not a joint optimum of FIRs, gains and bass timing, or an ISO loudness model.

coefficient_gain_reservation.notice: The same tenth-dB coefficient-reserve rule used in native preparation. Without optional encoder resources, the FIR peak supplies a necessary lower bound only; native preparation still checks the actual codec peak. This is not an acoustic clipping or driver-output certificate.

receiver_calibration.target_reference_rule: Per-curve baseline references, common within confirmed same-model groups; frozen from training before gain/menu selection

Flat / lr4.notice: Conservative coherent-input routing/FIR/output-level proxy. This excludes unknown AVR gain order, internal attenuation, driver distortion and available acoustic output; it is not a clipping or SPL certificate.

Reference / lr4.notice: Conservative coherent-input routing/FIR/output-level proxy. This excludes unknown AVR gain order, internal attenuation, driver distortion and available acoustic output; it is not a clipping or SPL certificate.

bass_routing_headroom_proxy.notice: All curve/model coherent-input routing bounds are retained. These are conditional proxies, not measured output, distortion, clipping or SPL limits.

receiver_calibration.notice: Complete selected static EQ targets and the declared LFE passband participate in coupled native controls. Every admissible sub-level, distance, polarity and linked crossover choice is covered conditionally on fixed FIRs and shared main ERB trims. Position/source/model risk is combined per curve, then across curves inside each group, then across groups. Actual encoder reserve is enforced when available; without it, a necessary FIR-only bound is reported. Direct complex-response checks retain every repeat. This is not a global FIR/trim/timing optimum or verified acoustic performance.

coupled_native_fixture.notice: Identity/+6.0206 dB complete FIRs with matching LF targets provide known gain/timing truth. This tests native control algebra, not learned-EQ quality or acoustic performance.

shared_controls_evaluation.notice: Reference EQ forward-evaluated with the selected common distance/level/crossover/polarity proposal held fixed. Selection source and participation are recorded separately. Every repeat and routing-model alternative is retained; holdouts never refit controls or references.

before.notice: Clock scale fitted from at least three known repeated pilots. The offset can include latency and a consistent room reflection; it is not a direct-arrival measurement. Stationary signal/path and a stable clock are assumptions. Existing deconvolved IRs cannot establish this fit.

after.notice: Clock scale fitted from at least three known repeated pilots. The offset can include latency and a consistent room reflection; it is not a direct-arrival measurement. Stationary signal/path and a stable clock are assumptions. Existing deconvolved IRs cannot establish this fit.

mapping.notice: A separate complete raw recording is resampled at continuous fractional positions. Original audio is retained. Finite sinc precision and edge padding are reported; this is not a lossless transform or an impulse-response deconvolution.

notice: Abstract known-solution native-menu and raw-recording fixtures. Native grid exactness is conditional on fixed FIRs, the proposed trim state and the declared model; it is not global acoustic optimality, OCA/GSonic equality or hardware validation.
